COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
C528 No.2033 of 2025
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Akshay Pradhan, learned counsel 
for the applicant.
2. Mr. Vikas Uniyal and Mr. Prabhat 
Kandpal, learned Brief Holders for the 
State of Uttarakhand/respondent No.1.
3. Pursuant to order dated 17.11.2025, 
learned counsel for applicant has filed 
supplementary affidavit, which is already 
on record.
4. By means of present C528 application, 
applicant has challenged the cognizance/
summoning order dated 12.08.2024 
passed by learned Judicial Magistrate-II, 
Roorkee, District Haridwar in Criminal 
Case No.2068 of 2024 State of 
Uttarakhand Vs. Tejpal, under Sections 
376(2)(l) and 376(2)(f) of the IPC and 
charge-sheet dated 10.08.2024, as well as 
the entire proceedings of Sessions Trial 
No.107 of 2024 State Vs. Tejpal, pending 
before learned FTSC/Additional Sessions 
Judge, Roorkee, District Haridwar.
5. The argument which has been 
advanced by learned counsel for applicant
is that the charges have been framed 
against the applicant only on the basis of 
statement recorded under Section 164 
Cr.P.C.
6. Learned counsel for applicant submits 
that the statement recorded under Section 
164 Cr.P.C., which are on record in a  sealed cover, cannot be opened by the 
Court itself without passing any order to 
open the same.
7. He further submits that statement 
under Section 164 Cr.P.C. was recorded 
after filing of the charge-sheet and that 
too cannot be done without any order 
from the Court.
8. Issue notice to respondent No.2, 
returnable within four weeks.
9. Steps to be taken within a week.
10. Respondents may file counter 
affidavit(s) within four weeks.
11. Put up on 06.01.2026.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.) 
 26.11.2025
PN
